evidence_sources: UN MTC Part III 38.3 + test summary 38.3.5
competent professional review with source reference
evidence_policy.source_caution: ADR 2025 2.2.9.1.10.5 contains a conditional Regulation (EC) 1272/2008 fallback when ADR aquatic data are not available. This evaluator intentionally does not auto-import CLP labels and requires Lead-approved separately evidenced fallback implementation.

thresholds.no_adequate_chronic_nrd_or_bioaccumulati: acute L(E)C50 <=1 -> Chronic1, >1 and <=10 -> Chronic2; ADR Table 2.2.9.1.10.3.1(b)(iii)

mandatory_evidence: adequate acute/chronic study or justified fallback
exceptions: BCF precedence over log Kow Note 5
unsupported: multiple differing trophic-level values and partial-data figure not fully automated

rules.scope: Constituent category summation for aquatic mixtures

thresholds.chronic_2: 10*SUM(C_i*M_i for Chronic1) + SUM(C_j for Chronic2) >=25 mass %
thresholds.acute_m_from_lec50: 1 for 0.1<x<=1; 10 for 0.01<x<=0.1; continue x10 per decade

rules.relevance: >=0.1 mass% for Acute1/Chronic1; >=1 mass% others, unless lower concentrations can be relevant. Evaluator conservatively includes all supported hazardous ingredients below these cutoffs rather than silently dropping them.
rules.unknown_data_effect: 2.2.9.1.10.4.6.5: no definitive hazard category; a known positive is reported only provisionally, a negative is indeterminate

formulas.chronic: EqNOEC_m = (SUM(Ci)+SUM(Cj)) / [SUM(Ci/NOECi) + SUM(Cj/(0.1*NOECj))], Ci RD and Cj NRD; classify calculated portion using RD criteria then sum

mandatory_evidence: measured acute and chronic endpoints for all additivity fraction constituents
comparable taxonomic endpoints or justified most-sensitive selection
rules.scope_limit: Requires complete acute and chronic endpoint evidence in each included raw constituent, otherwise indeterminate; may be stricter than full ADR workflow

rules.scope: Bridging only from evidenced ADR-category reference mixture
rules.scope_limit: Boolean preconditions are reviewer attestations, not a replacement for documentary comparability review

rules.scope: Environmental hazard as primary Class 9 vs additional hazard
mandatory_evidence: attested matching Table A row for PG
rules.pg_rule: PG III per 2.2.9.1.10.6 only with matching attested verified 2025 Table A row; no PG otherwise

thresholds.liquid_carriage_c: >=100 and, if flash point exists, carriage temperature < flash point

mandatory_evidence: flash_point or witnessed no flash point for liquid
rules.pg_rule: No PG emitted without verified row; no inferred PG

rules.scope: Specific M1/M2/M3/M4/M5/M8/M11 subclass criteria and entry-dependency gates
clauses: UN MTC Rev.8 Part III 38.3 and 38.3.5
mandatory_evidence: battery 38.3 type tests, design/QMP/test-summary if applicable
special-provision and named-entry applicability where relevant
rules.no_pg_entries: Leave PG absent until row-specific verification; many batteries/articles have no PG
